description:
Store.conn is pub(crate) but Store.events_tx is fully pub. Both fields are internal implementation details; neither should be reachable by dependents outside the crate.

kith-store/src/lib.rs line 63: pub(crate) conn — good, but inconsistent with line 69.
kith-store/src/lib.rs line 69: pub events_tx: Option<broadcast::Sender<StateChange>> — should be pub(crate).

The broadcast::Sender type from tokio is a third-party type. Exposing it as a pub field leaks the tokio broadcast channel as a stable API surface. Any downstream crate could read or clone the sender without going through set_events_tx(), breaking the invariant that events_tx is set exactly once after construction.

Fix: change pub events_tx to pub(crate) events_tx. The only external caller is set_events_tx(), which is already a pub method providing the controlled write path.
title: kith-store: Store.events_tx and Store.conn are pub but should not be
